recognize_zh: CD3 染色中，大片小型淋巴球為陰性，只有散在的小淋巴球呈棕色膜狀陽性（T 細胞），部分成小群；表示浸潤的主體不是 T 細胞，而是背景 T 細胞混雜於 B 細胞浸潤中，支持 CLL。
features: Diffuse sheets of small round lymphoid cells that are CD3-negative
Scattered CD3-positive small T cells with membranous staining, singly and in small clusters
CD3-positive T cells are small and cytologically bland
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD3 shows a diffuse infiltrate of small lymphoid cells that are negative, with scattered admixed small CD3-positive T cells distributed singly and in small clusters. The T cells are small and cytologically unremarkable. This pattern indicates that the infiltrate is composed predominantly of non-T cells with a reactive T-cell background. Together with PAX5 and CD5 positivity in the infiltrate, the findings support involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: A T-cell lymphoma would show sheets of CD3-positive cells rather than scattered T cells in a CD3-negative infiltrate.
THRLBCL has abundant CD3-positive T cells surrounding rare large CD20-positive B cells, not a small-cell CD3-negative sheet.
Reactive aggregates contain a mixture of T cells and B cells with T cells often predominating.
